fields.notes: The M_CAN module is delivered as synthesizable VHDL RTL — synthesis-time generic parameters (iso_only_g, connected_tsu_g, CREL year/month/day stamp) are documented but no SDC / floorplan / PDK constraints ship with the spec. Per-controller integration constraints — clock-tree budget for the two clock domains (m_can_hclk + m_can_cclk), maximum clock skew across the Sync block, transceiver pad ring, Message RAM access timing budget, RAM Watchdog (RWD.WDC) period choice — live in the integrator's SoC integration spec, not in the M_CAN User's Manual. The CAN FD data phase imposes stricter timing on m_can_cclk than Classical CAN (jitter + tolerance must be tight enough to meet ISO 11898-1:2015 at the target data rate, e.g. 5 Mbit/s at 4 tq bit time + 20 MHz m_can_cclk requires ≤0.1 % crystal). External Message RAM access latency budget must keep Tx Handler scan complete before the next Tx slot — see M_CAN Module Integration Guide [Ref 4] for guidance.

synthesis_generic_parameters.name: iso_only_g
synthesis_generic_parameters.purpose: 1 → CCCR.NISO fixed = 0 (M_CAN always operates per ISO 11898-1:2015 CAN FD format).

synthesis_generic_parameters.name: connected_tsu_g
synthesis_generic_parameters.purpose: 0 → CCCR.UTSU fixed = 0 (no external TSU connected); 1 → CCCR.UTSU writeable.

synthesis_generic_parameters.name: CREL.YEAR[3:0] / MON[7:0] / DAY[7:0]
synthesis_generic_parameters.purpose: BCD time-stamp set at synthesis (read-only in CREL register).

integrator_responsibilities: Choose Message RAM size + partition (filter list / Rx FIFO 0+1 / Rx Buffers / Tx Event FIFO / Tx Buffers); ensure non-overlapping start addresses.
External ECC / parity logic for Message RAM (feeds m_can_aeim_berr[1:0]); choose corrected vs uncorrected response policy.
RAM Watchdog start value (RWD.WDC); 0 disables the watchdog.
Interrupt routing (ILS / ILE / IE) per Host CPU's interrupt controller capabilities.
Bit-timing programming using a CAN bit timing calculator (CiA 601 gives guidelines).
m_can_cclk crystal / PLL choice with tolerance matching ISO 11898-1:2015 limits for the target data phase rate.
m_can_hclk choice (may be FM-PLL spread spectrum for EMC) — must satisfy m_can_hclk frequency ≥ m_can_cclk frequency.
